item.title: Whatever Works Recalls Microwave Grills Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard
item.company: Sold Online At: Whateverworks.com from January 2025 through June 2026 for about $22.
item.brand: Sold Online At: Whateverworks.com from January 2025 through June 2026 for about $22.
item.summary: This recall involves Whatever Works microwave grillers. The rectangular grills have a white plastic exterior with black locking clips on the side, hinge tabs at the rear, and two non-stick black metal plates. Model K4001 can be found on the product’s purchase receipt.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Whatever Works Microwave Grillers.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled grills immediately and contact Whatever Works for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write in permanent marker “Recalled” on the grill and send a photo of the marked grill to recall@whateverworks.com. Consumers will be provided with a prepaid label to return the recalled product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
